collections.name: Najma Collection
collections.description: Hand-crocheted from recycled T-shirt yarns, each Najma piece is a statement in conscious luxury.

products.name: Najma Tote Bag
products.description: A roomy, structured tote handcrafted in our signature colourway. Large enough for daily use, beautiful enough to turn heads.

products.name: Najma Shoulder Bag
products.description: Clean lines, comfortable straps, and that unmistakeable Stitch Bloom texture. The perfect everyday companion — now in a new Burgundy & Blue colourway.

products.name: Najma Mini Bag
products.description: All the Najma charm in a compact silhouette. Wear it crossbody or tuck it under your arm for effortless style.

products.name: Najma Handbag
products.description: A structured handbag that moves from brunch to evening without missing a beat. Available in two signature colourways.

products.name: Najma Clutch
products.description: Our most refined piece. The Najma Clutch is an heirloom-quality evening accessory, handcrafted in limited numbers.

collections.name: Signature Pieces
collections.description: Standalone designs made outside our main lines — each a distinct silhouette, hand-crocheted in small numbers.

products.name: Nwukabu Shoulder Bag
products.description: A striking triangular shoulder bag, hand-crocheted from recycled T-shirt yarn. Its sculptural shape and contrast trim make it a quiet statement piece — available in two bold colourways.

collections.name: Accessories
collections.description: Small but mighty — our accessory pieces bring the same handcrafted care to everyday essentials.

products.name: Key Holder
products.description: Keep your keys together in style. A small, crocheted key holder that clips to your bag or belt loop.

collections.name: Gadget Sleeves
collections.description: Protective crochet sleeves for your everyday devices — cushioned, stylish, and sustainably made.

products.name: iPad Sleeve
products.description: A fitted crochet sleeve for your iPad — protective, padded, and beautifully handmade.

products.name: Laptop Sleeve
products.description: Keep your laptop snug in a handcrafted crochet sleeve. Available in custom sizes — just let us know your laptop dimensions.
